Barbaracle

Rock Water

Kalos · Generation 6

Barbaracle is a Rock/Water-type Collective Pokémon first found in Kalos (Generation 6). It stands 1.3 m tall and weighs 96 kg. It evolves from Binacle. Its highest base stat is Defense (115), with a base stat total of 500.
